shots.visual_event: The train collapses around Nila; without Passenger Zero crossing, the master clock cannot restart and Tick cannot be recovered.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias: “The first debt must choose the new rule.”

shots.visual_event: Arin steps onto the red plaque and faces Nila exactly as he once faced Meera.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin: “Then take me. Let Nila leave.”

shots.visual_event: The plaque accepts and begins changing Arin into the new Conductor; a clock-mask forms toward his face.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nila: “You would give me the life your sister saved?”

shots.visual_event: Meera shatters the forming mask with Maya’s handbell before the exchange completes.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “That choice saved me once. It does not get to own him forever.”

shots.visual_event: Meera offers Nila the one memory shared by the whole city: everyone speaking a forgotten person’s name at midnight.
Nila hears her name carried by people who owe her nothing and finally takes Arin’s hand off the plaque.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nila: “No one takes my place.” Arin: “No one.”
